title.it: Introduzione allo Scrum e ai ruoli del team

summary.en: What Scrum is, the empirical foundation, the one Scrum Team and its three accountabilities.
summary.de: Was Scrum ist, die empirische Grundlage, das eine Scrum-Team und seine drei Verantwortlichkeiten.
summary.it: Cos'è lo Scrum, la base empirica, l'unico Scrum Team e le sue tre responsabilità.
summary.el: Τι είναι το Scrum, η εμπειρική βάση, η μία ομάδα Scrum και οι τρεις της αρμοδιότητες.
